since_start.notes: Trades before Aug 15, 2026 (e.g. June 2026 Coinbase de-risk, -$55k booked) are the prior manager's and excluded.
since_start.method: Combined P&L = book - start (estimate) - external flows. Flows = bank-funded buys + in-kind transfers in (PONS); moves between own accounts are internal. Per-person % = TWR (headline) and Modified Dietz (MWR); see people.method.

people.method: Headline return = time-weighted (TWR). Since-Aug-15 TWR = Dietz leg Aug 15 -> 2026-10-07 EOD (estimated start NAV) chained with a daily TWR after it; MWR = Modified Dietz (money-weighted) over the same window. The verified window starts at the first complete daily book (2026-10-07).
notes: Owner = owner-placed positions (UNI, DRIFT, SUI, NEAR, XRP, SUPER, PONS, BTC buys, OIL); Manager = everything else, incl. the $80k Oct 6 deposit it deployed.
Cash-pool buys (UNI Sep 3, DRIFT Sep 22, SUPER Sep 28, OIL ~Sep 17) default to OWNER; this is an assumption, toggle shows the other case.
PONS transfer-in counted as an owner in-kind flow at its Oct 12 market value, not as a gain or loss.
OIL (illiquid, written off by the manager) is shown at its book mark by default; toggle shows it at zero.
Owner % is small-base sensitive: money arrived in lumps; read the money-weighted (MWR) figure and the $ together.
Pre-Oct-7 daily books omitted staked assets and DEX-wallet holdings, so day-by-day NAV before Oct 7 is not trusted; since-Aug-15 uses the estimated start value.
